name: merton-earnings-tsla-2016-2026
clock: calendar time, 365-day year, uniform diffusion and jump intensity
volConvention: volBpsAnnual is TOTAL annualized vol; muJ, sigmaJ and sigmaE are the sizes at volRef and scale with vol / volRef, so jump variance = derived_jumpShare * vol^2 per year, earnings variance = derived_earningsShare * vol^2 per year (one release every cycleSecs), and diffusion variance = the rest
riskNeutral: drift rFree - lambdaYear*kappa(vol) between releases, each earnings move is N(-sigmaE(vol)^2/2, sigmaE(vol)^2) in log price; payouts discounted at rDiscount (the escrow earns nothing); Q parameters = fitted P parameters
